whatsNew.subject: What’s new in ToothOps
whatsNew.preheader: Sharper voice charting, chart by tooth, customization that fits your practice, and horses and rabbits.
whatsNew.title: ToothOps has grown a lot since launch
whatsNew.intro: Since ToothOps launched in November it has become a full chairside workflow for veterinary dentistry. Here are the highlights. Sign in to pick up where you left off.

item1.title: Voice charting, much sharper
item1.body: It catches findings split across pauses and your spoken corrections. When you stop, it re-reads the whole recording and lists anything it wasn’t sure about for review, saved with the visit. Transcripts are kept for replay, and dictation now covers CT reports and consultation and discharge notes in ten languages.

item2.title: Chart one tooth at a time
item2.body: Select a tooth on the numbered diagram and record everything for it in one place: pocket depths (a single reading, one per root, or six sites), diagnosis and procedure notes, quick codes, and extraction status. It edits the same chart as the grid, so you can switch views whenever you like.

item3.title: Make it yours
item3.body: Reorder, hide and add Patient sections and fields, including practice-wide custom fields. Edit Consult and Discharge templates and drag their sections into your own order. Set your own Imaging report labels and starter text, and save reusable treatment, radiograph and CT report templates.

item4.title: Images and imaging reports
item4.body: Pin photos and radiographs to teeth, and write radiographic and CT reports with AI refinement.

item5.title: Consultations, discharge and owner reports
item5.body: Visit-first notes, editable templates, and plain-language take-home reports with before and after photos.

item6.title: Horses and rabbits too
item6.body: A 44-tooth equine chart with diagram, grid and PDF, plus the AVDC equine findings and procedure codes. Rabbit dental charts alongside feline and canine, all with linked diagrams that stay in sync.

item7.title: Built for the whole practice
item7.body: Shared charts and templates, patient visit history, recheck reminders, and branded PDF charts you can re-import later. Use ToothOps in English, French, German, Italian, Spanish, Hungarian, Romanian, Chinese, Arabic or Polish.
